ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there are three charged thin metal plates placed vertically and parallel to one another, labeled in order as A, B, and C. The small holes at the centers of the three plates are on the same horizontal dashed line, labeled O, M, and P respectively. On the right side of plate C there is also a position labeled P', indicating the new position after plate C is translated to the right. Then reason: regard the charged thin metal plates as ideal parallel charged thin plates; the electric field intensity produced by a single charged thin plate on its two sides is independent of the distance to the thin plate. Now only plate C is translated to the right, while A and B do not move; therefore, in the original region from O to P, the electric field on the left side of plate C does not change because of the translation, and the resultant electric field between O and the original point P is still the same as before. Originally, the electron released from rest at point O could just reach point P, which indicates that the electron's speed is zero when it reaches point P. After plate C is translated, the electron's motion process from O to P is exactly the same as before, so its speed still becomes zero at point P; and the action of the electric field at point P on the electron makes it move to the left, so the electron returns at point P.

method.method_draft: 先从图中读出三块平行金属薄板 A、B、C 竖直放置，中央小孔 O、M、P 在同一水平虚线上，P' 位于 C 板右侧，表示 C 板向右平移后的新位置。由题文读出：电子从 O 静止释放时，原来恰好能到达 P；现在只改变 C 板位置。解题时把薄板看作理想带电平行板：单块带电薄板在其两侧产生的电场强度与观察点到板的距离无关，因此 C 板平移不会改变其左侧空间的电场；A、B 未动，所以 O 到原 P 点之间的合电场不变。原来电子从 O 静止出发恰好到 P，说明到 P 时速度为零。平移 C 后，电子在 O 到 P 的运动过程与原来相同，仍到 P 点速度变为零；而 P 点处电场方向仍使电子受到向左的力，因此电子在 P 点转向返回。结论：运动到 P 点返回。
